limitations: Windows packages unsigned; ARM64 built without physical-hardware execution.

Batch links are qualified on the retained synthetic sources and explicit selections. Each output is atomic per file; cross-file rollback and injected concurrent failures are not qualified.

Boundary fill is qualified on frozen synthetic raster geometry only. Resolution and threshold are explicit; open, ambiguous or excessive contours are refused. No physical measurement accuracy or native interaction is claimed.
Visual search accuracy is measured on controlled same-scale synthetic fixtures only; arbitrary symbol classes, angles and scale invariance are not qualified.
The 2-degree case is characterization only and is reported separately from required accuracy gates.
Native window controls are qualified only in the retained Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 X11/Openbox/Xvfb runs with software rendering; this does not qualify Wayland, physical GPUs or Windows interaction.

symbol_visual_review.scope: Visual inspection of 3 specified package-generated synthetic symbol diagnostic images; native desktop interaction and general real-plan qualification are outside this review.
observations: The displayed asymmetric templates and quarter-turns are distinct; expected and detected windows align on the synthetic vector, raster and noisy examples.
The cropped and rotated page-two comparison aligns the six shown matches. The mirrored distractor and empty square remain excluded.

The saved-page panels place count markers at explicitly selected centers; the partial acknowledged result contains its single accepted marker. This is inspection of three diagnostic images, not every generated image or native search interaction.

boundary_visual_review.scope: Visual inspection of 5 specified package-generated synthetic boundary diagnostic images; native desktop interaction and general real-plan qualification are outside this review.
observations: The independent two-hole comparison aligns the measured contour with the outer room edge and both enclosed holes.
The raw saved PDF and CLI preview retain both holes and the readable 2.9952 m2 label. The preview preserves the visible geometry.
The cropped quarter-turn comparison retains the rotated outer contour and both holes; the manual door closure closes the displayed bottom gap without leaking outside the room.
Five specified diagnostic images were inspected. This does not establish physical accuracy, native interaction or broader private-plan interoperability.

batch_visual_review.scope: Visual inspection of 11 specified package-generated synthetic batch diagnostic images; native desktop interaction and general real-plan qualification are outside this review.
observations: All four raw saved-page images preserve the visible identifiers, page borders and existing comment symbols. No new clipping or displaced page content is visible.
The first source comparison marks the two exact M-205 references and X-900; XM-205X and the same-source M-101 remain excluded. The cropped and rotated M-206 rectangle follows the visible text.
The second and third source comparisons mark M-101 and M-205 at their correct locations. The source preview retains the rotated M-206 page; the destination preview displays X-900.
The contact sheet agrees with the individually inspected raw pages, comparisons and CLI previews. Link destinations and output safety are covered separately by the recorded structural corpus.

batch_links_metrics.scope: Retained synthetic reviewed multi-source batches; independent original destinations and 22 saved PDFs verified. Per-file atomicity only.

ubuntu_native_review.scope: Final Ubuntu X11/Openbox/Xvfb light-theme software-rendered window controls.

reviews.observations: All five final-release captures are byte-identical to the five corresponding PR captures visually inspected in this session. Round minimize/maximize/close symbols are clear, spaced and aligned; the close hover is red with a white cross. The maximized view shows the restore symbol and preserves the document and tool layout. The unsaved-close dialog is legible, shows the modified-document marker and offers Cancel, Do not Save and Save without clipped controls. No blocking visual finding in these light-theme X11 captures; dark appearance, Wayland and physical GPU behavior are not qualified.
